title: Comparison of Plasma Dynamics in Coronal Holes and Quiet Sun Using Flux Emergence Simulations
evidence_note: The authors synthesize line intensity, velocity, and width for spectral lines they explicitly identify as observed by IRIS. In the ADS IRIS library.

title: Formation of Si IV due to the interaction of an electron beam with the flaring solar chromosphere
evidence_note: The paper calculates synthetic Si IV 1402.8 Angstrom intensities and profiles and relates them to the IRIS spectral window and exposure times. In the ADS IRIS library.

title: SPACE-SUIT: An Artificial Intelligence Based Chromospheric Feature Extractor and Classifier for SUIT
evidence_note: The authors analyze observed IRIS Mg II k full-disk mosaics and transform them into mock SUIT NB3 images at the same Mg II k wavelength, so both observational and synthetic bases apply. In the ADS IRIS library.

title: Bifrost Models of the Quiet Sun. I. Comparison with Solar Observations
evidence_note: The paper directly uses IRIS quiet-Sun observations, computes synthetic Mg II k and Si IV observables for comparison. In the ADS IRIS library.

title: Observational Analysis of Multithermal Counterstreaming Flows in a Forming Filament and Their Relationship with Local Heating at Filament Footpoints
evidence_note: The analysis uses IRIS slit-jaw images and calibrated Level-2 spectra of the filament. In the ADS IRIS library.

title: Origin of the Unusual Composition of 3He-rich Solar Energetic Particles
evidence_note: The source was coincidentally captured in IRIS Si IV 1400 and Mg II k 2796 slit-jaw images, but the slit crossed it only after the eruption and the authors neither analyze nor show IRIS data. Data availability is not use. Not in the ADS IRIS library.

title: Ellerman Bombs at High Resolution. IV. Visibility in Na I and Mg I
evidence_note: Paper IV of the Ellerman-bomb series analyzes SST Na I and Mg I data; the IRIS results of Paper III are discussed only for comparison. The library includes Paper III but not this paper, so a later series paper that analyzes different data is not a companion paper.

title: Prediction and Verification of Parker Solar Probe Solar Wind Sources at 13.3 Solar Radii
evidence_note: IRIS appears only as an example observatory and in the bibliography; the paper does not use IRIS data or IRIS-window synthetic observables.

title: Automated Detection of Solar Eruptions
evidence_note: The work uses SDO/AIA; IRIS is mentioned only for automatic HEK cross-referencing and possible subsequent studies.

title: Scientific Objectives and Capabilities of the Coronal Solar Magnetism Observatory
evidence_note: The accepted manuscript (the Deep Blue copy served by CORE) describes IRIS capabilities on pages 18 and 20 to motivate COSMO but does not analyze IRIS data or create IRIS-window synthetic observables. Not in the ADS IRIS library.

title: The Dynamics of the Extreme Ultraviolet Quiet Sun and Coronal Holes in the Solar Orbiter Era
evidence_note: A review that adapts an IRIS Si IV quiet-Sun/coronal-hole figure (page 8) and summarizes IRIS-based results (pages 7-10) without new IRIS analysis; a review substantially discussing IRIS results is left to the curator.

title: The Impact of the Angle-average Approximation in the Partial Frequency Redistribution Modeling of the Mg II h-k Doublet Stokes Profiles
evidence_note: The paper synthesizes Mg II h-k Stokes spectra, including intensity, within the IRIS NUV window. The modeling targets CLASP2 and IRIS appears only once in the background, so it qualifies by passband alone. Not yet in the ADS IRIS library.

title: Formation of Jet-driven Forced Reconnection Region and Associated Plasma Blobs in a Prominence Segment
evidence_note: The paper misexpands IRIS as 'Infrared Interferometer in Space' but cites De Pontieu et al. (2014), so it refers to the solar IRIS mission. IRIS appears only in background, a citation of an earlier IRIS study of the same event, and future work; the analysis uses SDO/AIA and STEREO-A/EUVI data.

title: Ellerman Bombs at High Resolution. IV. Visibility in Na I and Mg I
evidence_note: Preprint variant of mention_previous_iris_work. PDF pages 1-2 identify SST Na I and Mg I observations as this paper's analysis; pages 5-7 compare diffuse clouds with earlier IRIS results from Paper III. This is an analogy to a different observation, not an extension of the same IRIS event. The saved iris-v4.1 result incorrectly tagged COMPANION_PAPER.
label_source: Existing gold decision, checked against preprint text by Codex on 2026-09-29.

title: The Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph (IRIS)
evidence_note: The IRIS mission paper describes its instrument, operations, calibration and data products. PDF pages 32-38 analyze on-orbit IRIS measurements: focus tests, observed quiet-Sun line widths and orbital wavelength shifts. Pages 43-44 discuss modeling infrastructure and cite previous synthesis studies rather than presenting a new synthetic observable.
label_source: Source-text review by Codex on 2026-09-29; not independently curator-adjudicated.

title: MHD simulations of the in-situ generation of kink and sausage waves in the solar corona by collision of dense plasma clumps
evidence_note: PDF page 1 identifies Paper I as the modeling and observation of the 2014 April 3 IRIS/Hinode/SDO event. Page 2 explicitly expands the MHD model fitted to that same event, and page 11 connects the new parameter study back to it. The figures are plasma and magnetic-field diagnostics, not new IRIS observations or synthesized passband observables.
label_source: Source-text review by Codex on 2026-09-29; not independently curator-adjudicated.
